speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to my care. Since you are a newborn with a generalized rash, I need to know if you have any other symptoms like fever, poor feeding, or difficulty breathing? Also, has your mother had any recent illnesses or infections during her pregnancy?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text: I see the mother has a history of gonorrhea; does the rash appear as pustules or blisters, particularly on the palms and soles? Also, has the baby developed a purulent eye discharge or had a fever?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized erythematous maculopapular rash and pustules. I also have Rash with an erythematous base, Rash over the trunk and extremities, Sparing of the palms and soles.
